# Periclase B1: EOS reconstruction reports

<!-- Generated by scripts.generate_reconstruction_reports; edit EOSMAT instead. -->

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/mgo.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/mgo.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/mgo.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

<a id="record-mgo_b1_tange_2009_vinet"></a>

## Tange et al. (2009), pressure-scale-free Vinet-MGD

**close** · `mgo_b1_tange_2009_vinet` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mgo.md#record-mgo_b1_tange_2009_vinet)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

- The 164-row approximate reconstruction recovers all four independent Fit 3 coefficients within the numerical similarity limits, including over the tested 1-3% Zha-weight range. It is classified as similar, not parity, because the exact Zha rows and legacy weights are unpublished, one Fiquet state is unresolved, the Zha block is curve-based, and the restricted local inputs are not redistributed.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mgo\_dubrovinsky\_1997\_cod\_thermal\_expansion; mgo\_fiquet\_1999\_cod\_thermal\_expansion; mgo\_li\_2006\_table1\_elasticity; mgo\_marsh\_1980\_lasl\_single\_crystal\_hugoniot
- **Observations:** 164
- **Fit kind:** approximate\_coupled\_vinet\_mgd\_global\_reconstruction
- **Objective:** source-weighted thermal, elastic, and shock residuals
- **Free parameters:** K0\_prime; a; b; gamma0
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; n

### Curves and residuals

**Partial replay — available subsets only.**

PARTIAL REPLAY: these panels evaluate both stored coefficient sets only on the public bundled thermal-expansion, Li elastic and LASL shock subsets. They do not represent the complete 164-row approximate global reconstruction: restricted local legacy inputs are not redistributed, the Zha block is a surrogate, and original weights remain unresolved. The two dependent reference parameters are recomputed using the same documented thermodynamic constraints. RMS values apply only to the individually named public subsets.

<a id="record-mgo_li_2006_bm3_absolute_acoustic"></a>

## Li et al. (2006), acoustic absolute-pressure BM3

**close** · `mgo_li_2006_bm3_absolute_acoustic` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mgo.md#record-mgo_li_2006_bm3_absolute_acoustic)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

- Direct reproduction of the source measurement-to-coefficient chain, not a pressure-volume refit: the preferred decompression density, VP, and VS rows plus the independently measured ambient anchor are fitted to the published third-order acoustic finite-strain equations. Equation 4 then maps the fitted adiabatic K0S and K0S-prime to the stored isothermal K0T and K0T-prime; paragraph 10's K0T-in-L2/M2 approximation accounts for the measured isothermal strains. The calculated Table 1 pressures are downstream BM3 outputs and are never used as observations. The source does not publish its exact weights, iterative adiabatic-foot correction, covariance, or propagated isothermal errors, so the unweighted rounded-table reconstruction is classified as numerically similar rather than strict parity.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mgo\_li\_2006\_table1\_elasticity
- **Observations:** 11
- **Fit kind:** acoustic\_finite\_strain\_then\_isothermal\_conversion
- **Selection:** Section 2 ambient density/VP/VS anchor plus all ten Table 1 decompression-after-annealing density/VP/VS rows
- **Objective:** unweighted simultaneous VP and VS residuals in km/s
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

### Curves and residuals

![Source and refit curves with native-coordinate residuals for mgo_li_2006_bm3_absolute_acoustic](figures/mgo_li_2006_bm3_absolute_acoustic-curves.svg#only-light)
![Source and refit curves with native-coordinate residuals for mgo_li_2006_bm3_absolute_acoustic](figures/mgo_li_2006_bm3_absolute_acoustic-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Output / replay scope | Points | Residual units | Source RMS | Refit RMS |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| P-wave acoustic fit | 11 | km/s | 0.0222 | 0.0221 |
| S-wave acoustic fit | 11 | km/s | 0.0169 | 0.0169 |

The 11 measured density/VP/VS rows are the regression inputs. Calculated pressures are excluded. Curves replay the audit's explicit finite-strain room-temperature approximation, including K0T in L2/M2. Residuals and displayed RMS cover all 11 velocity rows; the separately recorded audit RMS covers only the ten high-pressure rows, excluding the ambient anchor. The catalog's isothermal K0/K0′ are derived from this acoustic fit; their parameter comparison remains separate.

<a id="record-mgo_shen_2026_vinet_3"></a>

## Shen and Smith (2026), Cu-referenced Vinet

**disagrees** · `mgo_shen_2026_vinet_3` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mgo.md#record-mgo_shen_2026_vinet_3)

**Warning:** Not recommended for quantitative use. Never chosen automatically; select it explicitly.

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Direct reconstruction from source observations: each Table S1 phase volume is paired with its simultaneous Cu volume, pressure is evaluated from Fratanduono et al.'s analytic third-order 298 K Vinet fit, and K0 and K0\_prime are fitted with Shen and Smith's fixed V0 and stated run selection. The source publishes no pressure weights, residual covariance, or weighting protocol, so the reproduction uses unweighted pressure residuals and does not infer any of them. The paper identifies Table II as direct fits to this study's Cu-referenced P-V data, with earlier literature included for comparison. Its data-availability statement also mentions other author-held data, so completeness of the actual author fit inputs is unconfirmed. No additional experimental fit rows are identified by the published fitting description. See the \[source-input audit\](literature-reproductions/shen-smith-2026-cu-refits.md). Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published fixed-V0 MgO Vinet curve gives 1.161241 GPa pressure RMS and residuals up to +2.8032 GPa on all 194 DAC-2 Table S1 observations. A direct unweighted refit gives K0=161.827434 GPa, K0\_prime=3.953583 and RMS 0.475879 GPa, versus published 161.9 GPa and 4.08. The source-fit discrepancy is unresolved.

**Source review:** `not_reproduced`.

- Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published fixed-V0 MgO Vinet curve gives 1.161241 GPa pressure RMS and residuals up to +2.8032 GPa on all 194 DAC-2 Table S1 observations. A direct unweighted refit gives K0=161.827434 GPa, K0\_prime=3.953583 and RMS 0.475879 GPa, versus published 161.9 GPa and 4.08. The source-fit discrepancy is unresolved.
- Usage recommendation: not\_recommended\_for\_quantitative\_use

## Luo et al. (2023), 0 K Vinet + Taylor thermal pressure

**untested** (not refittable) · `mgo_b1_luo_2023_vinet_thermal_5` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mgo.md#record-mgo_b1_luo_2023_vinet_thermal_5)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** A 12-residual primary-row sensitivity fit is executable, but it is not the source global refit: Kono's exact velocity-density regressions, the selected upstream shock/PVT rows, temperature/density error propagation, cross-observable normalization, and covariance are still unavailable. Tables II-III are excluded because they are derived EOS output.

- The large coefficient shift is evidence that substituting Li's low-pressure velocity ratio and retaining only Luo's new states does not identify the published global parameterization.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mgo\_luo\_2023\_table1\_shock; mgo\_li\_2006\_table1\_elasticity
- **Observations:** 12
- **Fit kind:** sound\_velocity\_quasi\_debye\_bounded\_partial
- **Selection:** all five Luo Table I P-V states, four reported temperatures, and three Eulerian sound velocities; all 18 Li ambient/high-pressure rows only determine the fixed proxy velocity-density regressions
- **Objective:** sum of squared shock-pressure, Hugoniot-temperature, and longitudinal-velocity residuals divided by their printed one-standard-deviation errors; printed two-sigma temperature errors are halved
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** V0; K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** Tr; molar\_mass\_g\_mol; n; Li proxy velocity-density coefficients

This is a qualified proxy-model comparison, not recovery of Luo's unavailable global input set, Kono regressions or calibration covariance.

**untested** (source calculation reconstructed) · `mgo_sokolova_2013_holzapfel_4` · `Holzapfel` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mgo.md#record-mgo_sokolova_2013_holzapfel_4)

**Scope:** Reconstruction of a source equation or calculation. **Basis:** All eleven machine-readable comparison series enter one shared Equation (20) objective against the mean Table 2 Holzapfel and Table 3 Vinet isotherm. Table 4 is retained as a post-calibration closure test. The calculation cannot recover the eleven EOS parameter sets independently because the source omits complete thermochemical/ultrasonic rows, weights, and covariance.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mgo\_jacobsen\_2008\_table1\_helium\_compression
- **Observations:** 45
- **Fit kind:** coupled\_eleven\_marker\_ruby\_cross\_calibration
- **Objective:** minimize the sum over markers of the mean squared residual between Equation (20) and the pointwise mean of the Table 2 Holzapfel and Table 3 Vinet pressures, so each of the eleven markers has equal total weight
- **Fixed parameters:** n; Z; n
